meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 的十条“好设计”原则逐条审计设计,每条打 0-3 分并附证据,给出新建/改进/重新设计的结论,并生成一个 /make-plan 计划提示。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说“audit this design”“design review”“check this UI against Rams”等,或要求对设计进行能导出方案的评审时触发。

say.text: 用 Rams 十条原则审计这个页面 UI。
say.note: Claude 会逐条打分并产出审计文件。

say.text: 审计这个设计,给出 REFINE 还是 REDESIGN 的裁决。
say.note: 同时生成可执行的 /make-plan 提示。

say.text: 对这套组件库做设计评审,并产出 /make-plan 计划。
say.note: 审计后直接进入后续计划阶段。

howto.what_en: Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten “Good design is...” principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, decides NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN, and hands off a /make-plan prompt. It does not write implementation code.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user says “audit this design”, “design review”, “check this UI against Rams”, etc., or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this page's UI against Rams' ten principles.
say_en.note: Claude scores each principle and writes the audit files.

say_en.text: Audit this design and give a REFINE or REDESIGN verdict.
Review this component library and hand off a /make-plan prompt.
say_en.note: After the audit it moves to the next planning phase.
